name: hotpatch
summary: Hot patches executables on Linux using .so file injection.
highlights: -v[vvvv] — Enable verbose logging. Add more 'v's for more
-N — Dry run. Do not modify anything in process
-l — Path or name of the .so file to load. Switches off execution pointer reset
-s — Symbol to invoke during the dll inject. Optional.
-x — Set execution pointer to symbol. Cannot be set with -s option
